## Company Overview

- Name: LeadFlowProTeam
- Type: Professional Service (web development and AI search visibility agency)
- Founded: 2026
- HQ: Remote-first, Bangladesh-based
- Markets served: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia
- Pilot market: Texas, United States (Hotels & Hospitality niche)
- Languages: English
- Audience: Investment-ready commercial businesses
- Slogan: "See How AI Sees Your Business. Fix the Gaps. Grow."
- Emails: info@leadflowproteam.com | sales@leadflowproteam.com | support@leadflowproteam.com

## What We Do

LeadFlowProTeam audits how a business is represented across search engines, local information sources, and AI answer experiences, identifies visibility and information gaps, then fixes the underlying information, technical, and content problems. The company builds modern Next.js websites optimized for both traditional SEO and AI answer engines (AEO/GEO/AIO).

## Process

1. Audit — evidence-based visibility assessment across search, local data, and AI answers
2. Prioritize — gaps ranked by business impact and effort
3. Implement — fix information, technical, and content problems
4. Monitor — ongoing optimization and re-testing across AI engines
